nudges.title: Spending is running above plan
nudges.headline: 18% over plan
nudges.body: Your last three months averaged $16,500/mo against a $14,000/mo plan — about 18% over. Travel and Gifts/Family account for most of the difference. At this pace it's worth checking what it means for the lake house timeline.

nudges.title: NVDA is a large share of your Robinhood account
nudges.headline: 54% of the account
nudges.body: NVIDIA Corp. makes up about 54% of your Robinhood account ($52,080). Single positions this large can swing the whole account. There are ways to reduce concentration over time — some more tax-aware than others.
